fences.rule: If the question is what the skill, the kin, or the right fetches when the main source fails, it is a floor and belongs there; if the question is where it fetches it and how the move changes the time until stopping, it is a clock and stays here.
fences.case: The nurse's licence as the income she can always fall back on.

fences.rule: Every item here presupposes that map's Larder countdown, a stock consumed at a rate read as the time remaining; the bare reading is that map's, and an item enters here only where the reading misreads.
fences.case: Thirty in cash over a burn of ten, read as three months.

fences.rule: If the stretch between collecting and paying really moves the balance and the months, nothing is misread and it is a margin mechanism there; if the stretch is tolerated only at the creditor's discretion or is seen and repriced, the misread is here as Forbearance clock or Watched burn.
fences.case: Paying every vendor thirty days later and calling the longer months runway.

fences.rule: If the operator's health is counted as an asset retained across a change of objective, it belongs there; if it is a clock drawn down by producing the very income the cash figure counts, it is here.
fences.case: The carpenter whose double shift lengthens the cash runway and spends the back's.
